author: ali-ahmad
answer: Any Wattlyst calculator can run on your own website for free. Copy the script code (resizes itself to fit) or, where your editor strips scripts, the iframe code (fixed height, shows the result first). Each embed shows a visible "Calculator by Wattlyst" link to the full page, which must stay in place. No ads, no tracking, results calculated in the reader's browser.

p: Free for blogs, installers, dealers, schools and forums. Keep the credit link visible and unchanged, do not frame the calculator inside ads or misleading text, and do not present its results as an official bill, quote or engineering sign-off. We may update a calculator's formulas or data at any time; your embed always shows the current version.
The embedded calculator carries no advertising and sets no cookies. Inputs are calculated in the visitor's browser and are not sent to Wattlyst.

Use the iframe code if your editor accepts HTML but strips scripts, as most forum and page-builder blocks do. Use the script code on your own site when you want the calculator to grow and shrink with its results instead of using a fixed height. In the iframe the result comes first, above the inputs, so it shows even in a short frame; raise the height if your page has room.
Want a calculator that is not listed or a version for your installer brand? Write to us through the contact page.
